Visit Elachee Today
Ignite Wonder
Meet native animals, explore hands-on science, and more. Elachee’s exhibits spark discovery for kids, families, and curious minds of all ages.
Embrace Wonder
Twelve miles of winding trails and room to roam. Hike the Chicopee Woods and feel the pace of life shift while you chase an adventure or are just catching your breath.
Know Before You Go
Location
Elachee Nature Science Center
2125 Elachee Drive, Gainesville, GA 30504
Hours
Mon-Fri: 12 PM – 3 PM
Sat: 10 AM – 4 PM
Sun, Mon & Tues: CLOSED
Open daily,
7 AM – Sunset
Admission
$10/Person (ages 4+)
$50/Family (max)
Free for members
$5/Vehicle
$10/ Vans & buses
$50/ Annual Pass
Free for members
Free access
What to Bring
Make a day of it! Enjoy your meal at one of our shaded picnic areas, on the Visitor Center patio, or at the Nature Nook reading platform. (And remember, pack it in, pack it out.)
We’re a forest, after all — best to come prepared.
You’ll be walking trails, climbing logs, and exploring outdoor play spaces. Dress for movement and maybe a little mud.
The most important thing to pack. From spotting a turtle to learning how bees work, there’s always something new to discover.
Hats, sunscreen, and rain jackets help keep your day comfortable. No matter what we’ll be open rain or shine.
There are no water fountains on the trails, so bring a refillable bottle and a few energizing snacks.
Plan Your Day at Elachee
Because curious minds deserve big adventures.
Pick Your Day
Elachee is open year-round (excluding major holidays), making it ideal for both spontaneous outings and planned adventures. Weekdays offer a quiet, relaxed atmosphere, perfect for stroller strolls and unhurried play. On Saturdays, the experience comes alive with live animal encounters, programs in our discovery dome, and hands-on activities for the whole family.
Start at the Visitor Center
Don’t forget to check out a Discovery Backpack to turn your walk into a nature scavenger hunt packed with tools and activity prompts that keep little explorers engaged.
Let Curiosity Lead the Way
Peek at turtles, wander the trails, build a stick fort, or play giant games at the Creation Station. There’s no schedule, just freedom to explore.
Break for Lunch (and a Breather)
Bring a packed lunch and relax at our shaded picnic areas, Visitor Center patio, or quiet Nature Nook reading platform. Don’t forget to pack wipes and a few extra snacks!
Head Home with Happy Kids
Expect muddy shoes and stories that start with “Did you see that?!”
Fun Things To Do At Elachee
or Outdoor Activity

Exciting Events. One-of-a-Kind
Elachee Experiences
Wildlife Festival
Get up close with reptiles, raptors, and more. Perfect for animal lovers of all ages, this festival offers interactive experiences and a petting zoo.
Camp Elachee for Adults
Embrace your inner child with activities like archery, live music, and guided night hikes. It’s camp — Elachee style.
Trillium Trek
Shake off winter on the trails of Chicopee Woods with 5K, 10K, and half-marathon options of a race that winds through scenic overlooks, creek crossings, and the season’s first trillium blooms.
What’s Happening at Elachee
Our recurring experiences invite you to return again and again, with the individual sessions that explore science, nature, creativity, and discovery.

Elachee for Grown-Ups
Let Nature Nurture Your Spirit
At Elachee, we believe nature isn’t just for kids and classrooms, it’s for anyone who needs space to breathe, time to reflect, and a reason to reconnect.
You’re Not
Looking For a Lecture —
You’re Looking for Peace
You don’t need a packed itinerary. You need permission to pause. Elachee’s grown-up programs are built around simplicity, curiosity, and presence, giving you time to notice the birdsong, feel the breeze, and remember what it’s like to be fully here. Whether you come with questions, a good book, or just to be present with nature, there’s space for you.
Why It Matters
Elachee’s adult programs are more than a way to relax, they’re an invitation to reconnect with the natural world and your place in it.
Every moment you spend here supports a greater mission, helping protect 1,440 acres of forest and inspire the next generation of environmental stewards.

Trails Around Elachee
Twelve Miles. One Wild Escape.
Winding through 1,440 acres of protected forest, Elachee’s 12-mile trail system offers something rare — real peace, just minutes from the city.
Whether you’re here to hike, reflect, or just breathe, these trails invite you to slow down and reconnect with the natural world.
You’re Not Just
Looking for a Hike
You’re looking for a trail that makes your shoulders drop and your mind wander. Elachee’s trails offer more than exercise, they offer space to think, move, and rediscover the calm that only nature can give.
Trail Highlights
12 Miles of Trails
Loop through hardwood forest, wetlands, creeks, and scenic overlooks.
Trailhead Access
From Elachee Visitor Center and Chicopee Woods Nature Preserve Parking.
Stroller Friendly
The Geiger Trail is a paved 1/3-mile trail suitable for strollers.

Volunteer with Elachee
At Elachee Nature Science Center, volunteers are essential partners in our mission. Whether you’re maintaining trails, supporting science
programs, assisting with events, or caring for our live animals, your time and talent help Elachee thrive.
Looking for a meaningful way to give back?
Join a dedicated community of nature lovers, educators, and conservation advocates. As a volunteer, you’ll make a tangible difference while gaining experience, spending time outdoors, and connecting with like-minded individuals.
Volunteer with Elachee
Fill out the form below to get involved as an individual volunteer and support Elachee’s mission through hands-on service and meaningful work.
Volunteer Groups
Elachee partners with schools, churches, civic clubs, and other organizations to create impactful group volunteer opportunities. Whether you’re clearing trails, assisting with educational programs, or helping with habitat restoration, your group can make a tangible difference in just a few hours.
Interested in scheduling a group volunteer experience?
Please complete the form below, and a member of our team will follow up to coordinate details and match your group with a project that fits.
Why It Matters
Because your time supports conservation, education, and community. Volunteers are at the heart of what we do — helping Elachee serve more than 35,000 students and visitors each year while preserving one of Georgia’s largest urban forests.
This is your chance to make a real and lasting impact.

Sci-Art Saturdays
January 10 - May 09, 2025
For kids who love both art and science, this 2.5-hour Saturday class at Elachee offers a unique, hands-on experience in natural science illustration. This course is taught by Noah Smith, who currently works as a Medical Illustrator within the University of Georgia College of Veterinary Medicine. He received his Master’s in Medical Illustration from Augusta University. Noah loves to share his passion for art and science, and is excited to spark an interest in scientific illustration within his students!
Each session begins with a guided hike through the Chicopee Woods, where students use observational sketching and note-taking to create their own handmade field guides. Afterward, the group transitions indoors for a deep-dive art project that brings a scientific theme to life through illustration.
Every month features a new theme—botanical illustration, animal anatomy, earth science, and more—so students can continue exploring fresh topics and skills. From watercolor bird studies inspired by Audubon to detailed insect diagrams and magnified plant drawings, these projects spark creativity while strengthening scientific observation.
Date: Jan 10 - May 09, 2025
Time: 10 AM - 12:30 PM
Price: $10/members, $12/students
Category: General Admission

Sips and Stars
February 14 - May 09, 2026
Join us for Sips and Stars, a relaxed evening for adults (21+) that blends astronomy, atmosphere, and a laid-back night outdoors at Elachee.
Enjoy a glass of wine while spending time under the stars, gathered around fire pits on the back patio. Throughout the evening, guests can explore the night sky through telescopes and planetarium shows, offering a closer look at celestial sights and seasonal highlights.
Sips and Stars is designed to be casual and welcoming — the perfect way to unwind, learn something new, and enjoy the outdoors in good company. Whether you’re celebrating Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, or simply a night out, this program offers a unique way to connect with the night sky.

Young Explorers Club
January 06 - May 28, 2026
Adventure awaits every week at the Young Explorers Club!
This hands-on program invites children to learn, discover, and explore through a blend of indoor activities, outdoor adventures or guided hikes, and an animal experience with one of Elachee’s resident ambassadors. Activities vary from session to session, so each visit brings something new and exciting.
Don’t miss the chance to experience Elachee’s brand-new Discovery Dome!
Select Young Explorers Club sessions will include special time inside the Dome on January 6, January 8, and January 22.
Two age groups participate during each session to ensure an engaging, age-appropriate experience:
Ages 3–6
Ages 7–12
NOTE: Families should be aware that siblings may be placed in different groups based on age. Please purchase tickets that match each child’s age.
Young Explorers Club is designed to spark curiosity and build confidence in nature. From animal encounters to themed activities and nature play, children will enjoy a meaningful outdoor learning experience in a fun, supportive environment.
Parents and guardians must remain on campus for the duration of the program. Pre-registration is encouraged; walk-ins are welcome based on availability.
This program will take place rain or shine. Please dress appropriately for the forecasted weather.
Special thanks to our 2025 Platinum Annual Sponsor Northside Hospital and our 2025 Silver Annual Sponsors Chattahoochee Marketing Group, Fieldale Farms Corporation, Mincey Marble Manufacturing, and Smith Gilliam Williams & Miles.
Date: Jan 06 - May 28, 2026
Time: 9 AM - 11 AM
Price: $9.60/members, $12/non-members
Category: General Admission
